zh: 重绘后的消息导航栏移至对话区左侧上方，展开卡片改为从左侧向右伸出，短横线贴左与轨道重合，指针移至短横线右侧文字区时列表保持静止
en: Move the redrawn message navigator rail to the top-left of the conversation area, opening its card to the right with left-aligned dashes over the rail marks and holding the list still while the pointer rests over the text to the right
